lead_raw_text:
The structure of Bi4Ga2As4 (reduced formula Bi2GaAs2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers coordinated by four As neighbors at 2.567 Å, while As centers have nine geometric neighbors (1 As, 4 Ga, 4 Bi) and Bi centers have ten neighbors (2 As, 8 Bi). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between As-centered 9-vertex polyhedra, corner-sharing between As- and Bi-centered polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Bi-centered 10-vertex polyhedra.
